title: Nissan eyes increasing U.S. production as new Rogue hybrid launches
summary: Nissan is considering adding production capacity at its Smyrna, Tennessee plant to manufacture the new Rogue hybrid, potentially creating hundreds or thousands of new jobs. The expansion reflects automaker confidence in U.S. market demand for hybrid vehicles. This represents potential economic growth in the manufacturing and automotive sectors.
content: Nissan has two production shifts at its assembly plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, and adding another could mean hundreds, if not thousands, of new jobs.

zh.title: 日产计划扩大美国产量，新款Rogue混合动力车上市
zh.summary: 日产正在考虑在其田纳西州斯迈尔纳工厂增加产能，制造新款Rogue混合动力车，可能创造数百或数千个新工作机会。这一扩产反映了该汽车制造商对美国混合动力车市场需求的信心。这代表了制造业和汽车行业的潜在经济增长。

title: Treasury yields ease as global borrowing costs tumble
summary: Treasury yields declined on Monday as borrowing costs fell globally following the previous week's interest rate volatility. Lower yields typically indicate reduced investor expectations for future rate increases. Treasury yield movements influence mortgage rates, business lending costs, and overall economic growth prospects.
content: Treasury yields were lower on Monday following last week's interest rate bonanza.

zh.title: 美国国债收益率下跌，全球借贷成本下降
zh.summary: 周一美国国债收益率下降，全球借贷成本在前一周利率波动后出现下滑。较低的收益率通常表明投资者对未来加息的预期降低。国债收益率的变动影响抵押贷款利率、商业贷款成本和整体经济增长前景。

title: Novo shares slide as drugmaker lays out post-Wegovy growth strategy
summary: Novo Nordisk shares declined as the Danish pharmaceutical company unveiled its strategy for growth beyond its blockbuster Wegovy weight-loss drug. The company is attempting to convince investors it can compete in the increasingly crowded obesity treatment market it helped pioneer. Investor skepticism reflects concerns about the company's ability to maintain growth momentum as competition intensifies.
content: The Danish company seeks to convince investors it can compete in an increasingly crowded field it helped pioneer.

zh.title: 诺和诺德股价下滑，公布韦戈比之后的增长战略
zh.summary: 丹麦制药公司诺和诺德股价下跌，该公司公布了超越其畅销减肥药韦戈比之外的增长战略。该公司正试图说服投资者，其能在自己帮助开创的日益拥挤的肥胖症治疗市场中竞争。投资者的怀疑反映了对该公司在竞争加剧情况下维持增长势头能力的担忧。

title: Tories pledge to bring back tax-free shopping for tourists
summary: The Conservative Party announced plans to reinstate tax-free shopping for international tourists, a benefit eliminated in 2021. The party argues that scrapping the scheme made the UK less competitive compared to European destinations for attracting luxury shopping tourists. Tax-free shopping policy directly impacts retail spending and tourism competitiveness.
content: The party says scrapping the scheme in 2021 left the UK less competitive than European destinations.

zh.title: 保守党承诺恢复游客免税购物
zh.summary: 保守党宣布计划恢复国际游客的免税购物优惠，这一优惠在2021年被取消。该党辩称，取消该计划使英国在吸引奢侈品购物游客方面的竞争力不如欧洲目的地。免税购物政策直接影响零售支出和旅游竞争力。

title: What are my rights if my flight is cancelled or delayed?
summary: Air traffic control problems are causing flight disruptions, prompting questions about passenger rights and compensation when flights are cancelled or delayed. Understanding legal protections helps travelers know what recourse they have when travel plans are disrupted. Passenger rights vary by jurisdiction and travel circumstances, making this information critical during operational challenges.
content: Flights are affected again owing to air traffic control problems, so what are your rights if you're affected?

zh.title: 如果我的航班被取消或延误，我有什么权利？
zh.summary: 空中交通管制问题导致航班中断，引发了关于航班取消或延误时乘客权利和赔偿的问题。了解法律保护有助于旅行者了解旅行计划中断时可获得的救济途径。乘客权利因司法管辖区和旅行情况而异，使这些信息在运营挑战期间至关重要。

title: ‘She says it’s just money’: My friend pays for everything. I should be grateful, but I can’t stand her anymore.
summary: A person struggles with a friendship where a wealthier friend consistently pays for expensive outings, spending approximately $500 per weekend trip, while the relationship is becoming strained. The dynamic creates uncomfortable expectations and power imbalances despite financial generosity. This illustrates how money-based relationships can undermine genuine friendships and highlights the importance of financial equity.
content: “On each of these weekends away, she’s probably spending $500.”

zh.title: "她说这只是钱"：我的朋友为所有事情付钱。我应该感激，但我再也受不了她了。
zh.summary: 一个人在与一个更富有的朋友的友谊中苦苦挣扎，这位朋友一直为昂贵的外出活动付款，每周末的旅行花费约500美元，而这段关系变得紧张。这种动态在财务慷慨的情况下产生了不舒适的期望和权力失衡。这说明了基于金钱的关系如何破坏真正的友谊，并强调了财务平等的重要性。

title: Stock futures rise slightly after Dow posts third straight losing week: Live updates
summary: Stock futures show slight gains as Wall Street recovers from the Dow's third consecutive losing week, signaling cautious optimism amid ongoing market volatility.
content: Wall Street is coming off a mixed week for the major averages.

zh.title: 道琼斯连续第三周下跌后股指期货小幅上升：实时更新
zh.summary: 在道琼斯连续第三周下跌后，华尔街出现回暖迹象，股指期货小幅上涨，显示出在持续市场波动中的谨慎乐观情绪。

title: Oil falls as crude flows remain 'surprisingly strong'
summary: Oil prices declined despite robust crude supplies remaining in the market, as traders monitor potential recovery in Saudi Arabian shipments amid Middle East tensions.
content: Oil fell Monday, as traders keep watch for a recovery in shipments from Saudi Arabia, even as Mideast tensions continue to escalate.

zh.title: 原油供应保持强劲，油价下跌
zh.summary: 尽管市场上原油供应保持充足，油价仍然下跌，交易员关注中东局势紧张背景下沙特阿拉伯出货量的潜在复苏。

title: Nvidia boss rejects AI extinction fears as 'doomsday narratives'
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismisses artificial intelligence existential risk concerns from researchers, characterizing such warnings as unfounded 'doomsday narratives.'
content: Jensen Huang's comments come after warnings from AI researchers that the technology could lead to human extinction.

zh.title: 英伟达首席执行官拒绝"末日论"式的人工智能灭绝担忧
zh.summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋驳斥研究人员提出的人工智能存在风险的担忧，将此类警告称为毫无根据的"末日论"。
